**Next.js** is on a canary release: `^16.3.1-canary.3` (pre-release build). - **React** and **React DOM** are pinned to `19.1.0`. - **AI SDK** packages (`@ai-sdk/react`, `ai`, `zod`, `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`) indicate this project is set up for AI/LLM integration. - Migration complete and build passes. Here's a summary of changes:

**Files created:**
- `app/layout.tsx` — Root layout merging `_document.tsx` (HTML structure, `lang="en"`) and `_app.tsx` (children rendering), with shared `metadata` export replacing `next/head` patterns
- `app/page.tsx` — Home page, migrated from `pages/index.tsx`; uses `Link` from `next/link` instead of `<a>` tags, exports page-level `metadata` instead of `next/head`
- `app/about/page.tsx` — About page, same migration pattern

**Files removed:**
- `pages/_app.tsx`
- `pages/_document.tsx`
- `pages/index.tsx`
- `pages/about.tsx`

All 3 routes (`/`, `/about`, `/_not-found`) compiled and generated as static pages successfully.
